Southwest Monsoon Withdraws from Entire Country, Northeast Monsoon Begins

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) announced on Thursday, October 15, that the Southwest Monsoon has withdrawn from the entire country. Concurrently, the Northeast Monsoon has commenced over South India. Data released by the IMD indicates a rainfall deficit associated with the retreating monsoon.
